n: SolarSync™ Outdoor Daylight and Color Temperature Sensor (GLS-LCCT)
d: GLS-LCCT Crestron SolarSync™ Outdoor Daylight and Color Temperature Sensor

specs.label: Sensor Technology
specs.value: Multi-Spectral Sensing Engine; measures color temperature and illuminance consistent with the CIE 1931 2° Standard Observer color coordinates

specs.label: NET
specs.value: (1) Attached 3 ft (0.91 m) cable with (4) flying leads, color-coded for connection to the Cresnet control network; Wire Gauge: 24 AWG (0.25 mm²)

specs.label: Housing
specs.value: PTFE with acrylic diffused dome, white finish, IP67 rated

specs.label: Mounting
specs.value: Mounts to an electrical j-box or enclosure (not included)via a 1/2 in. conduit knockout (0.885 in. ( 22.5 mm) actual hole size)

specs.label: Ingress Protection
specs.value: IP67 rated per IEC/EN 60529, dust tight and waterproof
